items.area: Fee-complete execution accounting before profitability or Auto-Paper promotion claims
items.next_action: W82: add a separately reviewed fee-complete execution accounting contract that binds Research fee assumptions to explicit simulated or authoritative PAPER fee evidence without fabricating fees inside the existing core Fill. Separate fee schedule assumptions from observed broker fees, preserve product/venue/account/order provenance, and keep profitability/PAPER-candidate claims blocked whenever fee evidence is missing or incomplete.
